patterns.note: A dynamic masonry grid layout is used for the main content area, continuously displaying a vast collection of images without distinct section breaks.
The top navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport, providing persistent access to site functions while the image grid scrolls infinitely beneath it.

The site employs a muted, monochromatic color scheme, primarily using a light background and dark text, allowing the sepia and grayscale tones of the historical images to dominate the visual experience.
Typography is minimal and functional, consisting of small, sans-serif text used for navigation and search, with no prominent headings, which emphasizes the visual content over textual hierarchy.

technique_notes: The primary content area utilizes a masonry grid system that dynamically loads and appends new images as the user scrolls down, creating a seamless infinite scroll experience.
The global navigation bar is implemented as a sticky element, fixed to the top of the browser window, ensuring it is always accessible regardless of scroll depth.
No scroll-triggered motion beyond the sticky header and continuous content loading; the design relies on static hierarchy and the inherent visual interest of the image content.

design_tokens.type_scale: Small, functional sans-serif text is used throughout for navigation and search, creating a flat typographic hierarchy that defers to the visual content.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are consistently applied to image frames, buttons, and the search bar, contributing to a clean and unadorned aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy spacing around individual images within the grid allows each piece of content to stand out, while the header maintains a balanced, functional density.

standout: The site's primary distinction is its absolute focus on the visual content, presented as an endless, unadorned gallery. The design itself is almost invisible, serving purely as a frame for the vast collection of historical and artistic public domain works, making the content the hero without any typical marketing flair.
